sources.description: MI300X environment capture (gfx942, 304 CUs, wavefront 64, 8 XCC, HBM 205822885888 B torch / 196288 MB amd-smi, rocminfo L1 32 KB / L2 4096 KB / L3 262144 KB, LLC 256 MiB registered, ROCm 7.14.0, torch 2.10.0+rocm7.1, HIP 7.1.25424, triton 3.6.0, Proton roctracer, HIP-graph timing fallback)
Framework architecture helpers and cdna3 LLC calibration comment (_AMD_ARCH, _LLC_BYTES, _LLC_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED, supports_tma, supports_tmem)
ROCm GPU hardware specifications table, MI300X row (VRAM, CUs, wavefront, LDS, L1/L2/L3, VGPR/SGPR file, GFXIP)
ROCm MI300X workload optimization page (XCD/CU/SIMD counts, LDS, L1, L2 per XCD, Infinity Cache, HBM3 capacity and bandwidth, max engine clock, matrix cores, VGPR allocation rule)

HIP hardware features table, CDNA3 column (wavefront 64, 1024 threads/block, 256 VGPR + 256 AGPR, 104 SGPR, matrix cores, FP16/BF16/FP8/TF32)
